title: Rhythm Starlane 节奏星轨
description: A 4-key falling-note rhythm game with three fully synthesized original tracks. Every song is generated live with WebAudio (lead melody, chord pads, drums and bass) and its chart is built from the song's own beat-pattern sequence — note times map exactly from beats to seconds, so what you hit is what you hear. Three difficulties (Easy/Normal/Hard) change density, double-note rate and scroll speed. Judge windows of ±40ms PERFECT and ±90ms GOOD feed combo multipliers (+5% every 25 combo), a Fever mode at 50 combo that doubles scores for 8 seconds with a full-screen light show, and an S/A/B/C/D accuracy grade on the results screen. Per-song per-difficulty best score and accuracy are saved locally.
controls: Press D F J K (or tap the four touch zones) to hit falling notes on the four lanes. ±40ms is PERFECT, ±90ms is GOOD, anything else is a MISS that breaks your combo. Every 25 combo adds +5% score bonus; reaching 50 combo triggers Fever (score ×2 for 8 seconds). P pauses (music stops too), M mutes, Esc or the ✕ button ends the song early for an aborted result.
author: LightGame
